top_choice_rationale: P001 best recognizes a mature, unified framework linking firm heterogeneity, endogenous selection, reallocation, and gains from trade. Melitz is foundational, while Helpman and Redding are defensible complementary recipients under a narrowly bounded citation.
recusal_note: I have co-authored work with committee colleague Timo Boppart and have long-term coauthorship ties with chair John Hassler; no direct connection to any proposed laureate is apparent from the supplied evidence.
